data.name: Kainat
data.gender_notes: Kainat is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic kawn, 'existence', from the root ك-و-ن (k-w-n), 'to be'. Its root is ك-و-ن (k-w-n). A common Muslim female name. Kainat is a Arabic name meaning “The universe; all creation”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kainat expresses “The universe; all creation”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic kawn, 'existence', from the root ك-و-ن (k-w-n), 'to be'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kainat total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
